FlipperDroid v2.0.0 - Professional Red Team Edition
====================================================

Release Date: 2026-09-11
Commit: 7844027a4f971f838aedc12285ef5b730e44f5cd
Tag: v2.0.0

🎯 MAJOR RELEASE - Professional Red Team Edition

This release introduces a comprehensive red team toolkit with 5 new attack/analysis modules
designed for authorized penetration testing and security research.

NEW FEATURES:
=============

1. BLE GATT Fuzzer
   - Discover vulnerabilities in BLE devices
   - 16+ fuzzing payloads (overflow, injection, format strings)
   - Automated GATT discovery
   - Real-time vulnerability detection

2. NFC Relay Attack
   - APDU exchange capture from NFC cards
   - Remote relay server support
   - Sequence replay for testing
   - Exportable capture logs

3. Packet Sniffer
   - Network traffic capture with tcpdump
   - BPF filter support
   - Real-time statistics
   - CSV export
   - Requires: Root + tcpdump

4. IoT Protocol Scanner
   - MQTT broker detection (1883)
   - CoAP server discovery (5683)
   - Common IoT service scanning
   - Topic/resource enumeration
   - Configurable IP ranges

5. Report Generator
   - Professional pentest report generation
   - CVSS scoring support
   - Multiple export formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON)
   - Statistical summaries

STATISTICS:
===========
- Files Added: 17
- Lines of Code: 2,849
- New ViewModels: 5
- New Screens: 5

LEGAL NOTICE:
=============
All features designed for:
✅ Authorized penetration testing
✅ Security research
✅ Vulnerability assessment with consent

Prohibited:
❌ Unauthorized network access
❌ Interception without consent
❌ Testing without authorization

Users must comply with all applicable laws (CFAA, GDPR, local regulations).
